subject: Approval request: premium onboarding + custom connector for ZenWell (ZW-347)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: premium onboarding + custom connector for ZenWell (ZW-347)

Team,

Quick background: ZenWell (digital care/coaching platform) is ready to move forward on a 12-month contract; initial ARR is ~$450k, expansion potential in EMEA in H2. They are requesting that we include our Premium Onboarding package (3 months dedicated onboarding + playbook + two enablement workshops) and build a custom connector to their patient-telemetry platform (estimated scope: ~120 dev hours).

Customer asks: 20% discount on list, Premium Onboarding included at no additional charge, and the custom connector delivered as part of M1. They want this in the signed SOW by the end of next week.

Attachments: ZW_SOW_v2.pdf (draft SOW), zw_pricing_model.xlsx (pricing + discount impact).

Why I think we should consider: strategic healthcare logo, potential multi-region deployment, strong reference case for telemetry connectors. However, the combo (discount + included premium onboarding + dev effort) puts margin risk.

Requesting: Deal desk / exec approval for: (a) non-standard inclusion of Premium Onboarding at no charge up to $25,000, (b) inclusion of custom connector up to 120 hours as a one-time deliverable (or capped and billed if over), and (c) a negotiated discount up to 20% but seeking leadership guidance on cap.

Next steps I propose: Karthik, can you run a cost impact (attached cost_model.csv would help) and advise acceptable discount cap? Marissa/Markus — can you weigh in on strategic value and whether to escalate to execs for sign-off?

Thanks,
Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0119
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: premium onboarding + custom connector for ZenWell (ZW-347)

Jonas — thanks for the write-up and the attachments. A few clarifying items before I run numbers:

- Confirm the 120 hours is for Redwood dev only (no customer-contributed work)? If there is any co-dev the billing model changes.
- Is the Premium Onboarding the "Premium" SKU (includes dedicated onboarding manager + 2 enablement workshops)? If so, list price is $30k.
- What SLA tier are they asking for on the connector post-handover (standard vs premium)?

I've attached a quick cost_model.csv to the thread and will model the P&L for 18% and 20% discount scenarios. Initial read: including premium onboarding and 120 dev hours at 0 charge with 20% discount reduces YoY margin to below our threshold unless we cap hours or require partial prepayment.

I'll need signoff from Sales leadership for any discount >18% or onboarding credit >$25k. Also looping in Legal if we need non-standard IP/ownership language for the connector.

-Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk, Revenue Operations
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: premium onboarding + custom connector for ZenWell (ZW-347)

Thanks for raising this, Jonas. I agree this is strategically interesting and worth pursuing but recommend the following compromise to protect margin and set clear precedent:

- Approve inclusion of Premium Onboarding as a one-time credit up to $25,000 (not full free retail value).
- Approve custom connector as a deliverable capped at 100 hours; any scope beyond that to be handled via a change order at $200/hr (or external contract).
- Cap discount at 18% contingent on 50% upfront payment on signature and a 12-month committed term.

Rationale: preserves some margin, gives customer meaningful value, keeps future change orders clear. I recommend we escalate to Evelyn for final exec signoff given deviation from standard SKUs and the custom-dev ask — this is above my approval threshold for exceptions.

I've attached an internal one-pager with ARR/ACV impact (exec_summary_zenwell.pdf). Jonas — if you can confirm we get 50% upfront and ownership model for the connector (we should retain IP with a perpetual license), I will move forward with escalation.

-Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Evelyn — forwarding the thread. Recommended exception summary below (per Marissa/Karthik):

- Discount cap: 18%
- Premium Onboarding credit: $25,000 (one-time)
- Custom connector capped at 100 hours; post-cap billed at $200/hr with a formal change order
- 50% prepayment on signature, 12-month minimum term, Redwood retains IP ownership with a perpetual license to ZenWell

This gives a defensible commercial position while allowing us to close a strategic customer. Seeking your signoff to proceed and instruct Legal (Ava) to finalize SOW redlines and DocuSign flow.

-Markus

Thanks — I approve the exception with the following firm conditions:

1) Discount limited to 18% maximum.
2) Premium Onboarding credit capped at $25,000 (no additional onboarding credits).
3) Custom connector: approve up to 100 hours delivered by Redwood; any additional hours require a signed change order and written approval from Sales Ops.
4) 50% payment on signature, remainder net 30 days.
5) Legal (Ava) to confirm IP clause in SOW ensures Redwood retains ownership and grants a perpetual, non-exclusive license to ZenWell for their deployment.

This exception is approved for this deal only. Any similar ask going forward must be routed to me for review. Ava — please prepare final redlines and the DocuSign envelope. Jonas — please confirm ZenWell accepts prepayment and IP terms before we issue the final SOW.

Evelyn
